messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98432 fired for service=route-proxy-heartbeat (us-west-2). symptom=5xx-rate > alert threshold. auto-escalation to on-call.

mike: acked. I'm waking up the chain, on it. :coffee:

jess: I see the spike on grafana — synthetic canary requests showing 5xx burst starting ~14:20 UTC. p95 latency fine, but error rate jumps to ~4.8% for ~30s. link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/route-proxy

mike: grabbing logs from the probe host now. running: 
```
# quick tail from probe logs
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=canary-prober --tail=200 | grep route-proxy
2026-03-15T14:20:11Z probe route-proxy 502 upstream read timeout
2026-03-15T14:20:12Z probe route-proxy 502 upstream read timeout
```

jess: hmm looks like the canary probe timed out talking to a backend shard. customer traffic not spiking on SLOs dashboard (no user error pages). check traces?

ana: pinging infra team — any deploys around 14:18-14:22? I don't see any CI jobs in the window. :eyes:

kevin: no infra deploys. Just some autoscaler noise in the region, but nothing that should cause 502s for the probe.

mike: ran a quick K/V cache warmup query and backend health check, backends returned healthy. suspect transient network flake. re-ingesting metrics: `sum(rate(http_errors_total{route="/proxy"}[1m])) by (pod)` — noisy for one minute, then back to baseline.

jess: PD auto-resolved at 14:21:12 (incident-bot). I can confirm metrics returned to normal at ~14:22. No customer-facing increase in 5xx seen in real traffic.

mike: marking as no-customer-impact. will file a short postmortem entry and add extra noise suppression for the canary probe alert to prevent re-triggering on 1-minute flakes.

ana: agreed, add a small debounce (30s->90s) and require >1 pod affected. also record that this was likely a transient network path hiccup.

jess: leaving a runbook note: 
- cause: transient upstream timeout affecting canary probe only
- impact: none (no real-user 5xx increase)
- mitigation: none required; auto-resolved
- action: tweak alert debounce + add pod-count filter

sre-bot: follow-up ticket created: INFRA-1421 "Canary probe alert: debounce and multi-pod guard" (prio=P3).

mike: handing off to ana for the follow-up. ana — you up for owning the ticket?

ana: yup, I'll own INFRA-1421. assigning to myself and will triage tomorrow. thanks for quick ack/triage everyone. :thumbsup:

kevin: closing thread. feel free to re-open if it flares again.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98432 auto-resolved by monitor at 3079998892.

mike: final note — no escalation required, no customer incidents reported.
